name: Verify hash of stored bitstream data matches a stored hash
description: Compares a hash computed over stored bitstream data against a recorded hash, to assess whether the stored data has changed since it was written.
details:
The stored hash may be held inside the forensic image container, in an associated text file, or in a separate trusted location. 

The same comparison applies in each case. The hash over the stored data is produced by DFT-1199 (Compute hash of stored bitstream data), and a hash held inside a container is read using DFT-1193 (Read metadata from within a forensic image container). 

This technique covers verification carried out after imaging has finished, whereas DFT-1042 (Verify hash of copied data matches the hash of the data read from source device) covers the comparison made *during imaging* against a hash of data read from the source device.
